From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@maplewood.com>

Subject: Trouble accepting supplier invite — keeps redirecting to login

Hi Marcus,

We received the supplier invite and when I click the Accept button in the email, the browser opens the Redwood supplier portal but immediately bounces me to the login page. I sign in with our SSO, and instead of landing on the activation page it redirects back to the portal root with a flash of the acceptance URL. Tried in Chrome and Safari with the same result.

I attached the original invite (invite-email.html) and a screenshot of what happens (screenshot-login-500.png). Can you help? PO process is blocked until we activate the account.

Thanks,
Tom Alvarez
Head of Procurement
Maplewood Electronics

Attachments: invite-email.html (text/html), screenshot-login-500.png (image/png)

Subject: Re: Trouble accepting supplier invite — keeps redirecting to login

Hi Tom — thanks for the clear repro and files. Sorry for the disruption. Two quick troubleshooting items while I loop in eng:

1) Can you confirm whether your browser is set to block third-party cookies?
2) If you open the invite link in an incognito window and perform SSO, do you see the same flip back to the root?

I suspect the Accept flow is losing the session cookie on path scoping when the SSO returns. Ben and Laura — flagging potential cookie path/sameSite mismatch for this invite flow.

I'll start a ticket with infra and share a short repro.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-14T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting supplier invite — keeps redirecting to login

Looping Eng: INF-4521 created. Notes from quick inspection: the invite acceptance cookie is being set with Path=/portal/activate but the SSO assertion endpoint is hosted under /sso/complete which then issues a Set-Cookie: Path=/ that overwrites the earlier scoping in some browsers. On return, origin check fails due to SameSite=Lax and the ephemeral redirect loses the activation token.

Workaround to test with customer: set cookie enforcement off in the proxy for this tenant (temporary) and resend the invite. Laura, can you coordinate a short tenant-level proxy patch and an invite resend?

—Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Product Ops
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-08-15T08:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting supplier invite — keeps redirecting to login

Tom — small change on our side worked in internal test. We've applied a tenant-scoped header that pins the cookie path to /portal/activate during the invite flow; this prevents the SSO completion from widening the cookie scope. I'm about to resend the invite with a short expiry (24h) so we can confirm.

I will send the new invite in ~10 minutes. If you still see the bounce, please capture a browser devtools network trace and drop it to this thread.

Thanks for your patience — Laura

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-08-16T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: follow-up after HAR — escalate to infra network team

Internal notes (not for customer): HAR shows that some IE/Edge-based enterprise proxies strip Path attribute during Set-Cookie rewrite; workaround must be on the proxy edge to preserve Path and SameSite attributes. Eng suggests a short-lived redirect that passes the activation token in the fragment (client-only) to avoid cookie mutation during the SSO hop. I've asked INF-4521 owners to evaluate risk and ETA.

Action items:
- Ben: get approval for tenant proxy change window (2–3 hour maintenance).
- Laura: schedule invite resend and customer communication with a clear maintenance window.
- Marcus: draft rollback plan and tests.

—Marcus
